notes: Native 4K (4096x2160), 50,000-lumen 3-chip DLP laser projector, no lens included (sold separately). Ships with the ET-MDN12G10 12G-SDI interface board pre-installed in Expansion Slot 1 (2x dedicated SDI inputs + 2x switchable SDI in/out, all BNC), which is why the 4 SDI ports above are listed as standard I/O. A second Expansion Slot (Slot 2) is empty from the factory and is SLOT NX-compatible with optional interface boards not included in this listing: Interface Board for HDMI (ET-MDNHM10, 2x HDMI IN), DVI-D (ET-MDNDV10, 2x DVI-D IN), DisplayPort (ET-MDNDP10, 2x DisplayPort IN), or 12G-SDI Optical (ET-MDNFB10, 1x SFP in / 1x in-out) — none of these are physically present unless purchased and installed. Desktop/floor-or-ceiling install unit (126 kg / 278 lbs), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Primary source: Panasonic's official global spec page (docs.connect.panasonic.com/projector/products/rq50k/spec/) and Options page, cross-verified against the official PT-RQ50K Operating Instructions PDF (na.panasonic.com/ns/286110_rq50k_manual_en.pdf) for exact terminal labels, SDI/USB/Ethernet grade details, and AC IN electrical/mechanical specifics.

ports.name: SDI 1 IN
ports.note: Supports HD-SDI/3G-SDI/6G-SDI/12G-SDI. Part of the ET-MDN12G10 12G-SDI interface board that ships pre-installed in Expansion Slot 1.

ports.name: SDI 2 IN/1 OUT
ports.note: As an input, limited to HD-SDI/3G-SDI only. As an output (menu-switchable), acts as an active through terminal passing whatever signal (up to 12G-SDI) was received on SDI 1 IN.

ports.name: SDI 4 IN/3 OUT
ports.note: As an input, limited to HD-SDI/3G-SDI only. As an output (menu-switchable), passes through whatever signal (up to 12G-SDI) was received on SDI 3 IN.

ports.name: DIGITAL LINK
ports.note: HDBaseT-compliant single-cable video/audio/Ethernet/control (100Base-TX), HDCP 2.2 and Deep Color compatible.

ports.name: MULTI PROJECTOR SYNC IN
ports.note: TTL sync input (high impedance) for multi-projector brightness/color matching, not a video signal so no SDI bandwidth grade applies.

ports.name: SERIAL IN
ports.note: D-sub 9-pin (female), RS-232C compliant, for computer control.

ports.name: SERIAL OUT
ports.note: D-sub 9-pin (male), RS-232C compliant, for link/daisy-chain control.

ports.name: REMOTE 1 IN
ports.note: M3 stereo mini-jack for wired remote control.

ports.name: REMOTE 1 OUT
ports.note: M3 stereo mini-jack for linking multiple projectors' wired remote control.

ports.name: REMOTE 2 IN
ports.note: D-sub 9-pin (female) for external contact-closure/parallel control, not literal RS-232C signalling; mapped to the closest available D-sub connector id.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB Type-A host port for the optional AJ-WM50 wireless LAN module or a USB memory stick (USB 2.0 compatible per operating instructions).

ports.name: DC OUT 1
ports.note: USB Type-A shaped connector, power supply only (DC 5V, 2A total shared with DC OUT 2), no data.

ports.name: DC OUT 2
ports.note: USB Type-A shaped connector, power supply only (DC 5V, 2A total shared with DC OUT 1), no data.

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Single locking (quarter-turn twist-lock) AC inlet, not hot-swap capable; supports AC100-120V (11.5A, 15A outlet) or AC200-240V (20.8A, requires 30A NEMA L6-30 outlet). Closest standard connector id chosen from the allowed list; actual connector is a proprietary Panasonic locking inlet, not a plain IEC C19 socket.
